title: Deep Learning Models Also Recall Features
abstract: arXiv:2608.20970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work in mechanistic interpretability has studied how large language models recall facts stored in their weights. This paper argues that factual recall points to something broader: a general kind of operation in deep learning models, which I call feature recall. The core observation is that a linear projection can be read as retrieving stored information scaled by input activations. I define feature recall, show it applies across architectures, and contrast it with the established paradigm of feature combination. I also consider how cases of feature recall might be mechanistically identified. The account gives philosophers a new conceptual tool for understanding deep learning, and points to empirical directions for mechanistic interpretability research.

translated_title: 深度学习模型同样能回忆特征
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20970v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：近期在机制可解释性方面的研究探讨了大型语言模型如何回忆存储在其权重中的事实。本文认为，事实回忆指向了一个更广泛的现象：深度学习模型中的一种通用操作类型，我称之为特征回忆。核心观察是，线性投影可以被解读为检索存储的信息，并按输入激活进行缩放。我定义了特征回忆，展示了它如何适用于各种架构，并将其与已确立的特征组合范式进行对比。我还考虑了特征回忆案例在机制上可能如何被识别。这一观点为哲学家提供了理解深度学习的新概念工具，并为机制可解释性研究指明了实证方向。
tldr: 本文提出“特征回忆”概念，指出深度学习模型中的线性投影可视为按输入激活缩放地检索存储信息，与特征组合范式形成对比，为哲学理解和机制可解释性研究提供新视角。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "feature recall," arguing that linear projections in deep learning models can retrieve stored information scaled by input activations, contrasting with feature combination, offering new philosophical insights and empirical directions for mechanistic interpretability.
